name: Bell's Brewery Grassroots Water Stewardship Grants
summary: Small brewery-funded grants for water stewardship projects in the US that protect ecosystem health and biodiversity or build resilience to climate-related water risks. No open round is stated on the page.

eligibility.rule: Is not for political campaigns, religious purposes, media projects or event sponsorships
Is not a public or private school
Does not request capital campaign, pass-through, general operating or facilities funding
Has not received more than $2500 in Bell support in a calendar year, unless it is a 2025 grantee

geography.quote: Organizations in all 50 states and DC, are eligible for funding.

amount.quote: Grassroots grants range in size from $500 to $5,000.

applicant_types.quote: We Do Not Fund: Organizations without 501(c)3 status Debt reduction Individuals

access.quote: Please review our grant guidelines in full before applying.

window.quote: Grassroots Grant Cycle 2026 Focus Area-Water Stewardship
